description: Weather forecast for coordinates or a city name: current temperature, humidity, wind, cloud, pressure and conditions, an hourly forecast up to 48 hours, and daily highs, lows and rain up to 7 days. Data from MET Norway. Use for travel, event or logistics planning. Not for past weather or official warnings. Times in UTC. Typical response under 1 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

country.description: Optional country code for the city, such as SG.

lat.description: Latitude; send with lon, or send city.
